theme: Dark technical/hacker-style dashboard theme. A clean, professional blend of Retro-Futurism (Terminal) and Swiss High-Contrast architecture.

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for ALL technical data: IP addresses, Ports, Latency (ms), Connection Strings, and Logs.
Headings should use Cabinet Grotesk with tight tracking (tracking-tight) for a technical brutalist feel.
Body text should use IBM Plex Sans for maximum legibility.
All overlines/labels (e.g., 'ACTIVE PROXY', 'LATENCY') must be JetBrains Mono, uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] with a muted foreground.
installation_commands: No direct npm install for Google fonts required; add to HTML head or use standard import techniques.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look) & Subtle Terminal Glow
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders (border-[#1A1A1A]) on cards. Expose the grid skeleton where possible using border-collapse layout.
visual_enhancers.glow: Add drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_var(--primary-glow)] to active connection statuses and primary buttons for that hacker/cyber aesthetic without overdoing it.
visual_enhancers.texture: Apply a subtle CSS radial gradient or scanline noise overlay to the Architecture Flow Visual background.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace soft shadows with sharp 1px solid strokes or inner glows.

grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Narrow, left-aligned, border-r border-[#1A1A1A]. Contains navigation icons and API Key Setup modal trigger.
grids_and_layouts.main_content: Dense Bento-style grid with generous padding (p-8).
bento_grid: Top Row: Active Proxy Hero Card (col-span-1 md:col-span-4) + Architecture Flow Visual (col-span-1 md:col-span-8).
Middle Row: Proxy List Browser & Filters (col-span-1 md:col-span-8) + Proxy Health Test & Fetch/Try It Widget (col-span-1 md:col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use gap-6 between major bento cards, but keep internal card spacing dense (p-4 or p-6) for a data-heavy feel.

proxy_list_browser.style: Dense tabular layout, monospace IPs. Sticky header.
proxy_list_browser.features: Include inline Country flags next to ISO codes. Use standard Shadcn Table component.

filter_controls.style: Compact select dropdowns and search inputs with a terminal-like caret.

active_proxy_card.style: High-contrast card with an animated 'Active' pulsing dot (bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse). Prominently display connection string.
active_proxy_card.instructions: Use a heavy bottom border (border-b-2 border-primary) to anchor it.

architecture_flow_visual.style: Interactive or static flow: FloppyData -> Proxy List -> Selected Proxy (Highlighted) -> Your Server -> Your Web.
architecture_flow_visual.instructions: Use React Flow (if complex) or simple flexbox with SVG connecting arrows. The 'Selected Proxy' node should glow cyan.

proxy_health_test.style: Terminal-style output window for 'Fetch / Try It'.
proxy_health_test.instructions: Darker background within the card (bg-black) with monospace output. Status badges for Alive (Laser Green) and Dead (Signal Red).

status_badges.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm), no background, just 1px border and text colored based on status.

motion.micro_interactions: Fast, precise, non-bouncy transitions. Use transition-colors duration-150.
motion.loading_states: Use terminal-style loaders (e.g., repeating ASCII dots or block cursors) instead of standard spinners.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in from the bottom for list items in the Proxy Table.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against dark backgrounds meets APCA standards.
accessibility.focus_states: Sharp cyan outline (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none) on all inputs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.instructions: Rely heavily on typography and SVG iconography for technical dashboards. No generic placeholder images.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React frontend using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Ensure dark mode is forced on by setting 'dark' class on HTML or wrapping root.
Customize tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (background: #050505, primary: #00E5FF, etc.) and fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono).
Install lucide-react if not present, and setup Shadcn components (Table, Badge, Card, Input, Select, Button, Dialog).
For the 'Architecture Flow Visual', you can build a custom SVG/flexbox diagram that looks technical, with glowing paths.
Do not use generic blue/purple gradients. Stick strictly to the monochrome + neon accent color palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Create depth through layered design elements (1px borders, subtle inner glows), not soft drop shadows.
Use glass-morphism (backdrop-blur) only on sticky headers or modals.
Never use placeholder text or emojis for icons.
Ensure all components have data-testid attributes.
DO NOT use a completely transparent background in overlays or dropdowns.
